```{r}
#determine max y axis value
max(-log10(don$p.values))
don <- wind2  %>% 

  # Compute chromosome size
  group_by(chr) %>% 
  summarise(chr_len=max(pos)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate cumulative position of each chromosome
  mutate(tot=cumsum(chr_len)-chr_len) %>%
  dplyr::select(-chr_len) %>%
  
  # Add this info to the initial dataset
  left_join(wind2, ., by=c("chr"="chr")) %>%
  #left_join(west_g2_out) %>% 
  
  # Add a cumulative position of each SNP
  arrange(chr, pos) %>%
  mutate( BPcum=pos+tot) %>%
  
  # Add highlight and annotation information
  mutate( is_highlight=ifelse(outlier == "yes", "yes", "no")) #%>%
  #mutate( is_annotate=ifelse(gene != "noname", "yes", "no"))

axisdf <- don %>% group_by(chr) %>% summarize(center=( max(BPcum) + min(BPcum) ) / 2 ) %>% mutate(CHR2=if_else(chr==38,"W",if_else(chr==39,"Z",as.character(chr))))

# Make the plot
g_1<-ggplot(don, aes(x=BPcum, y=-log10(p.values),color=as.factor(chr))) +
  
  # Show all points
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=0.9,shape=1) + 
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0278) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("#666666","#999999", "#CCCCCC"), 31 )) +
  
  # custom X axis:
  scale_x_continuous( label = axisdf$CHR2, breaks= axisdf$center,guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2,angle = 0,check.overlap=T)) +  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0) ) +     # remove space between plot area and x axis
  
  ylim(0,25.00) +
  # Add highlighted points
  
  geom_point(data=subset(don, is_highlight=="yes"), color="#069E73", size=1) + #green:AZ,shared
 # geom_point(data=subset(don, sharedoutlier=="Guerrero_specific"), color="#F0E442", size=1) +
  # Add label using ggrepel to avoid overlapping
 # geom_point(data=subset(don_all, is_highlight=="no"), aes(x=BPcum,y=FLFST), size=1,color = "#000000",shape=8) +
  
#  geom_label_repel(data=subset(don, is_annotate=="yes"), aes(x=BPcum,y=FLFST,label=gene), size=2,segment.color = "black",segment.size = .2,min.segment.length = unit(0, 'lines'),nudge_y = .03,max.overlaps = 50) +
  
  # Custom the theme:
  theme_bw() +
  theme( 
    legend.position="none",
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color='light gray'),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5)
  ) +labs(x="Chromosome",y="-log10(p-value)")
g_1
```
## Save as high resolution png file
```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "WAVI.188ind.noHyb.Rdadapt_outlier_manhattan_plot.01pvalue.png",
  plot = g_1,      # or your specific plot object, e.g., manhattan_plot
  width = 12,              # inches — adjust based on how wide your Manhattan plot needs to be
  height = 6,               # inches
  dpi = 600,                # 300 = standard "high-res"; 600 = print-quality/journal-grade
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"               # ensures no transparent background issues
)

## Now plots East vs. West, West vs. SW and Blackhills vs West and Southwest.
```{r}
e_w<- read_delim('West_rmrelnoIBD.East_rmrelnoHZ.50000bp_window.tsv', delim="\t", col_names = T)

sw_sd<- read_delim('BlackHills.Southwest.50000bp_window.tsv', delim="\t", col_names = T) 


#Genome assembly Cyanocitta cristata (blue jay) for VGP reference genome, bCyaCrs1: WAVI RAGTAG is associated with these chrom numbers
chromosome_map <- c(
 "CM100531.1_RagTag" = "1", "CM100532.1_RagTag" = "2", "CM100533.1_RagTag" = "3",
 "CM100534.1_RagTag" = "4", "CM100535.1_RagTag" = "5", "CM100536.1_RagTag" = "6",

 "CM100549.1_RagTag" = "19", "CM100550.1_RagTag" = "20", "CM100551.1_RagTag" = "21",  "CM100552.1_RagTag" = "22", "CM100553.1_RagTag" = "23", "CM100554.1_RagTag" = "24", "CM100555.1_RagTag" = "25", "CM100556.1_RagTag" = "26", "CM100557.1_RagTag" = "27", "CM100558.1_RagTag" = "28", "CM100559.1_RagTag" = "29", "CM100560.1_RagTag" = "30",
   "CM100561.1_RagTag" = "31", "CM100562.1_RagTag" = "32", "CM100563.1_RagTag" = "33", "CM100564.1_RagTag" = "34", "CM100565.1_RagTag" = "35", "CM100566.1_RagTag" = "36",
   "CM100567.1_RagTag" = "37","CM100568.1_RagTag" = "38", "CM100569.1_RagTag" = "39"
 )

 
e_w$chr <- chromosome_map[as.character(e_w$lg)]

w_sd$chr <- chromosome_map[as.character(w_sd$lg)]
sw_sd$chr <- chromosome_map[as.character(sw_sd$lg)]

head(wind)
e_w2<-e_w %>% 
  mutate(outlier=if_else(fst > quantile(e_w$fst, probs = 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),"yes","no")) %>%

  mutate_at(c('chr'), as.numeric) %>% na.omit() 
e_w2_out<-e_w2 %>% filter(outlier=="yes")

w_sw2<-w_sw %>% 
  mutate(outlier=if_else(fst > quantile(w_sw$fst, probs = 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),"yes","no")) %>%

  dplyr::select(-chr_len) %>%
  
  # Add this info to the initial dataset
  left_join(w_sd2, ., by=c("chr"="chr")) %>%
  left_join(w_sd2_out) %>% 
  
  # Add a cumulative position of each SNP
  arrange(chr, pos) %>%
  mutate( BPcum=pos+tot) %>%
  
  # Add highlight and annotation information
  mutate( is_highlight=ifelse(outlier == "yes", "yes", "no")) #%>%
  #mutate( is_annotate=ifelse(gene != "noname", "yes", "no"))

axisdf <- don_wsd %>% group_by(chr) %>% summarize(center=( max(BPcum) + min(BPcum) ) / 2 ) %>% mutate(CHR2=if_else(chr==38,"W",if_else(chr==39,"Z",as.character(chr))))

# Make the plot
g_wsd<-ggplot(don_wsd, aes(x=BPcum, y=fst,color=as.factor(chr))) +
  
  # Show all points
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=0.9,shape=1) + 
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0278) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("#666666","#999999", "#CCCCCC"), 31 )) +
  
  # custom X axis:
  scale_x_continuous( label = axisdf$CHR2, breaks= axisdf$center,guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2,angle = 0,check.overlap=T)) +  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0) ) +     # remove space between plot area and x axis
  
  ylim(-0.05,1.00) +
  # Add highlighted points
  
  geom_point(data=subset(don_wsd, is_highlight=="yes"), color="#009E73", size=1) + #southwest
  geom_point(data=subset(don_wsd, sharedoutlier=="BlackHills_specific"), color="#CC79A7", size=1) + # blackhills outlier not found in west vs southwest outlier

  # Add label using ggrepel to avoid overlapping
 # geom_point(data=subset(don_all, is_highlight=="no"), aes(x=BPcum,y=FLFST), size=1,color = "#000000",shape=8) +
  
#  geom_label_repel(data=subset(don, is_annotate=="yes"), aes(x=BPcum,y=FLFST,label=gene), size=2,segment.color = "black",segment.size = .2,min.segment.length = unit(0, 'lines'),nudge_y = .03,max.overlaps = 50) +
  
  # Custom the theme:
  theme_bw() +
  theme( 
    legend.position="none",
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color='light gray'),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5)
  ) +labs(x="Chromosome",y="FST")

don_swsd <- sw_sd2 %>% 
  # Compute chromosome size
  group_by(chr) %>% 
  summarise(chr_len=max(pos)) %>%

  left_join(sw_sd2, ., by=c("chr"="chr")) %>%

  # Add highlight and annotation information

  #mutate( is_annotate=ifelse(gene != "noname", "yes", "no"))

axisdf <- don_wsd %>% group_by(chr) %>% summarize(center=( max(BPcum) + min(BPcum) ) / 2 ) %>% mutate(CHR2=if_else(chr==38,"W",if_else(chr==39,"Z",as.character(chr))))

# Make the plot
g_swsd<-ggplot(don_swsd, aes(x=BPcum, y=fst,color=as.factor(chr))) +

  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0278) +

  # custom X axis:
  scale_x_continuous( label = axisdf$CHR2, breaks= axisdf$center,guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2,angle = 0,check.overlap=T)) +  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0) ) +     # remove space between plot area and x axis
  
  ylim(-0.05,1.00) +
  # Add highlighted points
  
  geom_point(data=subset(don_swsd, is_highlight=="yes"), color="#E69F00", size=1) + #southwest
  geom_point(data=subset(don_swsd, sharedoutlier=="BlackHills_specific"), color="#CC79A7", size=1) + #southwest

  # Add label using ggrepel to avoid overlapping
 # geom_point(data=subset(don_all, is_highlight=="no"), aes(x=BPcum,y=FLFST), size=1,color = "#000000",shape=8) +

  # Custom the theme:

    legend.position="none",
